learner.background: Senior full-stack engineer, no formal CS degree. Comfortable in Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
learner.goal: FAANG-level DSA fluency — definitional knowledge, conversational metaphors, optimization intuition, and the ability to explain trade-offs out loud.
learner.tone: Rigorous but unjargon-y. Real-world analogies for every concept. No babying, no condescension.
learner.engagement_style: Hands-on drills and reps over capstone projects. Notebook-style export for personal deep-dive notes.

modules.title: Mental Model — How to Think About Algorithms
modules.summary: The interview-shaped mental model: Big-O on a napkin, what memory actually is, recursion as a call tree, and the four-act structure of every interview answer.

lessons.title: Big-O — The Napkin You Sketch in Interviews
Memory — Why Arrays Beat Linked Lists in Practice
Recursion, the Call Stack, and Invariants
The Interview Pattern — Clarify, Brute, Optimize, Code, Test

modules.title: Arrays, Strings, and Hashing — The Workhorses
modules.summary: The two structures that power 60% of FAANG interviews. Arrays under the hood, hash tables (and the lies they tell), two-pointers, and sliding window.

lessons.title: Hash Tables — The Magic and the Lies

modules.title: Stacks, Queues, Deques
modules.summary: LIFO/FIFO under the hood, monotonic stack tricks, and the patterns that turn O(n²) into O(n).

modules.title: Linked Lists, Trees, and Recursion
modules.summary: When pointers help, the call-tree intuition for recursion, and binary tree traversals as muscle memory.

lessons.title: Linked Lists, Trees, and the Call Tree

modules.title: Heaps & Priority Queues
modules.summary: The shape, the bubble dance, and why top-K problems are basically free if you can spell heapify.

modules.title: Graphs — BFS, DFS, Topological Sort
modules.summary: Representations, traversals, and the dependency-resolution problem in disguise.

modules.title: Searching & Sorting
modules.summary: Binary search as answer-space search, the sort family tree, and quickselect tricks.

modules.title: Dynamic Programming, Greedy & Backtracking
modules.summary: Overlapping subproblems, state design, and the controlled brute force.

modules.title: Advanced Data Structures — Tries, DSU, LRU, Bits
modules.summary: The four DS that show up in senior FAANG interviews and almost nowhere in college: prefix trees, union-find, LRU cache, and bit manipulation.

lessons.title: Bit manipulation — when integers are sets
